title: DAY 26/90
MACHINE ELEMENTS
scenes.voice: Day twenty six of the GATE M. E. ninety days challenge, and eighty one days to go. Today we look inside the machine: shafts, bearings, brakes and clutches.

scenes.title: Today's Topic
scenes.voice: Subject, machine design. Topic, machine elements. These parts bring easy, formula based marks in GATE every single year.

scenes.title: Cover Today
scenes.voice: Cover shafts under combined bending and torsion, gears and rolling and sliding contact bearings, brakes and clutches, and springs.

scenes.title: Quick Tip
scenes.voice: Quick tip. Rated bearing life, in million revolutions, is C over P raised to k. Use k equals three for ball bearings and ten by three for roller bearings.

scenes.title: Today's Plan
scenes.voice: The free practice PDF is on Telegram now. Test tonight, seven to nine P. M. Take it through the link in our Telegram channel, or simply visit our website, on mobile or laptop.
